findings.title: next 16.3.5 sits behind GHSA-vcvr-r3jv-pc5j (critical, patched in 16.3.6) and nothing in CI runs pnpm audit
findings.evidence: pnpm audit --prod (2026-10-06): 'critical Next.js: Remote Code Execution in next/og ImageResponse, vulnerable >=16.2.0 <16.3.6, patched >=16.3.6, path .>next' plus two high (braces via next>sass>chokidar, source-map-js via next>postcss). src/ has no import of next/og or ImageResponse and next.config.ts has output:'export', so the RCE path is not reachable in this build; the advisory is still open against the pinned version and .github/workflows/ci.yml has no audit step.
findings.impact: Not exploitable as built (static export, no next/og). But VERIFICATION.md line 57 promises 'No silently suppressed critical/high runtime vulnerability' and the pinned next stays red in every audit; a Cloudflare Pages build log or a buyer-side scanner shows a critical advisory on the launch commit.
findings.proposed_fix: Bump next and eslint-config-next to 16.3.6 (pnpm up next@16.3.6 eslint-config-next@16.3.6), re-run pnpm check, and add a `pnpm audit --prod --audit-level=high` step to ci.yml so a new advisory turns the job red instead of staying invisible.
